description.value: The Carnegie Branch is a Vancouver Public Library location housed inside the historic Carnegie Centre building at Main and Hastings, a landmark 1903 Carnegie library in the heart of Vancouver's Downtown Eastside. It serves as both a public library and part of a broader community centre complex, making it a well-used stop in one of the city's most densely walkable and transit-rich neighbourhoods. Touring cyclists passing through the area will find it a convenient urban rest point.
